decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and publicly presented the semi-hard cheese wheel since 2018, and it is central to its organic cheese range, so management is likely to persist despite any disappointing results.
As a product line with several models, the spicy cheese represents a larger and more visible commitment, increasing the tendency to escalate commitment and keep it.
The mild creamy soft cheese builds on the firm's established offer and has been publicly promoted with its own page, so sunk costs and public commitment make dropping unlikely.
